snippet.title: Dream Village - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's an Announcement Trailer for Dream Village, a casual, cozy village design simulation game developed by VIVA. 

Players will establish a home of their own to manage a farm, order groceries, and live a life of simplicity. Dream Village is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#DreamVillage #CozyGames #SimulationGames
